summary: Tested the new cookie-consent system (own implementation) and the new logo system (customer standard PNG logo + 'logo-light' admin slot) end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_logo_light.py (14 tests) covering logo-light lifecycle (404 clean state, auth required, upload/serve byte-identical, invalid MIME 415, oversize 413, delete + idempotent delete), slot independence (logo vs logo_light), /api/media/info shape (logo_light key present, no _id) and a contact-form regression (submit -> appears in /api/admin/requests -> delete). Full suite: 59/59 passed. Frontend (Playwright 1920/768/390): CONSENT — banner on first visit, never on /admin, 'Nur notwendige' stores {v:1,necessary:true,rest:false} and never reappears (SPA nav + reload), 'Alle akzeptieren' (banner + modal) stores all true, settings modal shows 4 categories with role=switch, necessary locked (aria-checked/aria-disabled true + 'Immer aktiv', click is a no-op), exact selection persisted (stat+ext true, marketing false), footer-cookie-settings opens modal preloaded with stored state and revoke-to-necessary works without re-showing the banner, version bump (v:0) re-triggers the banner, ESC closes without saving, focus starts on close button and Tab cycles only inside the modal (verified 12 tabs), no overflow at 390/768 and modal fully inside viewport. LOGO — desktop navbar /logo-standard.png @60px (scale 1.5), mobile <lg /logo-compact.png capped 44px, footer + open mobile menu use the light variants; admin Medien tab has the new 'Logo für dunklen Hintergrund / Helles Logo' card (media-logo-light-*) with light-standard placeholder on dark background; uploading a white PNG makes footer + mobile menu use /api/media/logo-light instantly after SPA navigation (no reload) while navbar keeps the light-bg logo; both slots are fully independent (upload/delete of one does not affect the other); deleting logo_light falls back to the uploaded normal logo, deleting both falls back to logo-standard(-light).png. Scaling 50/300/700/150 % applies instantly (20/120/280/60px), mobile stays capped at 44px with no overflow and the menu button never covered. Standard-logo downloads return 200 PNG (hrefs /logo-standard.png, /logo-standard-light.png, verified via HTTP + PNG magic bytes). REGRESSION: contact form submit (success panel), admin login, all 5 admin tabs, share-image/favicon cards OK. Zero JS console errors and zero >=400 responses in all flows. One real UI defect found (cookie banner covers the last mobile menu link).

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (390px) with no consent stored yet, the fixed cookie banner (z-[70]) is painted over the open mobile menu overlay (z-40). document.elementFromPoint on the 'Kontakt' menu link returns the banner text, i.e. the last nav link is not clickable while the banner is shown. Fix: hide the banner while the mobile menu is open (or raise the menu above z-70).

issues: 'Alle akzeptieren' / 'Nur notwendige' labels wrap onto two lines inside the buttons at the md:flex-col breakpoint (max-w-4xl column layout) — add whitespace-nowrap or widen the action column.

Cosmetic: after uploading/deleting one media slot the sibling MediaCards keep stale info because MediaCard only reloads /media/info on its own action; it does not listen to the 'cleanora-media-changed' event (visible only if two slots are changed in one session without reload).

action_items: Hide the cookie banner while the mobile menu is open (or z-index/stacking fix) — currently the banner blocks the last mobile nav link on first visit.
Optional: prevent button label wrapping in the banner action group on desktop.
Optional: let MediaCard subscribe to 'cleanora-media-changed' so all media cards refresh together.
critical_code_review_comments: CookieConsent focus trap collects focusables via 'button, a[href]' only; if an input/select is ever added to the modal it will escape the trap — use a broader focusable selector.
Toggle for 'necessary' uses aria-disabled without the disabled attribute: correct for a11y, but note Playwright/AT treats it as not-enabled (clicks are ignored, verified as intended behaviour).
consent.js saveConsent() only whitelists statistics/marketing/external — good; loadConsent() correctly invalidates on version mismatch (verified with v:0).

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all 16 requested checks pass except mobile menu/banner overlay)

seed_data_creation: Temp PNGs /tmp/TEST_light_logo.png and /tmp/TEST_dark_logo.png uploaded to both logo slots and deleted afterwards; one contact request (TEST_UI_CONSENT_REG) created via UI and deleted in the Anfragen tab; logo_scale cycled 0.5/3/7 and restored to 1.5. Final state: no custom logos, logo_scale=150%, no test requests left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend suite: /app/backend/tests/test_logo_light.py (logo-light lifecycle, slot independence, standard PNG assets, contact regression). Consent testids verified working: cookie-banner, cookie-accept-all, cookie-accept-necessary, cookie-open-settings, cookie-settings-modal, cookie-toggle-{necessary|statistics|marketing|external}, cookie-save-selection, cookie-accept-all-modal, cookie-settings-close, footer-cookie-settings. For 'fresh visitor' use localStorage.removeItem('cleanora_consent') then re-goto. The necessary toggle has aria-disabled -> normal clicks time out (expected); assert aria-checked instead. Instant-apply can be exercised with history.pushState + PopStateEvent. Logo selectors must be scoped ([data-testid="main-nav"]/footer) because logo-link exists multiple times. State left clean.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile overlay bug: Navbar mobile menu uses z-40 while the consent banner uses z-[70] and is fixed to the bottom; both can be visible simultaneously on a first visit, so the banner paints above the menu and intercepts pointer events for the lowest menu entry (verified via elementFromPoint returning the banner paragraph over the 'Kontakt' link).
